name: Terra Space - GDELT DOC Scheduled Collector (SEA/ASEAN/SCS)

parameters.content:
GDELT supplies article discovery metadata. Full article text must be fetched separately from the original publisher, subject to access rules.

Operational notes:
- DOC API caps at maxrecords=250 per request, no offset pagination. If a run returns exactly 250 articles, some articles in that window were likely NOT captured (see window_possibly_truncated column in Supabase).
- Schedule interval and the HTTP Request 'timespan' param (currently: 24h) must be changed TOGETHER if you switch cadence (e.g. to 48h).
- Requires the Supabase table 'gdelt_doc_articles' (already created) with a UNIQUE constraint on source_url.
- Query is filtered to a curated domain allowlist (~26 ASEAN/regional/wire/PRC-state outlets, using 'domain:' to catch subdomains) AND sourcelang:english. Edit the domain list directly in the GDELT DOC Search node's query parameter if sources need to change.
- Not live-verified against GDELT due to persistent rate-limiting during setup (2026-07-28) - verify results on first real run.

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: ("South China Sea" OR ASEAN OR "Southeast Asia") (domain:channelnewsasia.com OR domain:scmp.com OR domain:asia.nikkei.com OR domain:thediplomat.com OR domain:asiatimes.com OR domain:benarnews.org OR domain:reuters.com OR domain:apnews.com OR domain:aljazeera.com OR domain:bbc.com OR domain:rappler.com OR domain:inquirer.net OR domain:philstar.com OR domain:e.vnexpress.net OR domain:vietnamnews.vn OR domain:tuoitrenews.vn OR domain:thestar.com.my OR domain:freemalaysiatoday.com OR domain:thejakartapost.com OR domain:en.antaranews.com OR domain:straitstimes.com OR domain:todayonline.com OR domain:bangkokpost.com OR domain:nationthailand.com OR domain:globaltimes.cn OR domain:chinadaily.com.cn OR domain:cgtn.com) sourcelang:english
